notes: PCA congregation planted about 30 years ago in the Catalina Foothills; it also runs Pusch Ridge Christian Academy. LEADERSHIP IS IN TRANSITION: lead pastor John Stone resigned in April 2024, the PCA posted a lead-pastor search profile in June 2025, and the church has been run in the interim by Executive Pastor Paul Utnage with Associate Pastors Rob Pendley and Chad Turner, an Executive Director (Byron Johns) and a Director of Shepherding (Dr. John Miller). That means recent sermons are split across several preachers, so per-sermon attribution is essential - do not attribute the whole archive to one person. An earlier directory snippet called Paul Utnage 'Lead Pastor'; the church's own Facebook post introduced him as Executive Pastor, which is the title recorded here. Coordinates left missing: Orange Grove Rd's latitude could not be fixed against the reference grid. Sermons are podcast and live-streamed; no YouTube channel URL confirmed.
